symptom: Importing vector store or startup code fails before the API can run.
cause: The pymilvus package is not installed in the active Python environment.
fix_steps: Run python -m pip install -r requirements.txt in the project root.
Confirm python -c "import pymilvus" works in the same environment.
On Windows, milvus-lite is skipped by the platform marker; use external Milvus or Docker if Lite is required.

error_pattern: pip install error on milvus-lite in Windows
symptom: Dependency resolution or installation fails for milvus-lite on Windows.
cause: milvus-lite wheels are not available for the Windows runtime used by the project.
fix_steps: Keep milvus-lite behind a non-Windows environment marker.
Use Docker or a remote Milvus service for Windows development.

error_pattern: Traceback shows JSONDecodeError in evaluation CLI
symptom: Agent course evaluation stops while reading a JSONL dataset.
cause: One line in the JSONL file is malformed or contains invalid quoting.
fix_steps: Validate that each non-empty line is one complete JSON object.
Fix the line number reported by the loader.

error_pattern: FastAPI startup error connecting vector database
symptom: uvicorn starts but app initialization fails when creating the vector store.
cause: STUCKTOSHIP_MILVUS_URI or Milvus server configuration is missing or incompatible with the local platform.
fix_steps: For Windows, prefer an external Milvus endpoint instead of local milvus-lite.
Run python -m compileall -q core services main.py to rule out syntax errors first.

symptom: A caller passes unsupported arguments to the Agent course orchestrator.
cause: QAOrchestrator.answer accepts query plus optional session_id and user_id keyword arguments.
fix_steps: Call answer(query, session_id=..., user_id=...) with keyword arguments.
Keep subject and grade filtering in the higher-level RAGService or future course retriever.
Add a focused test before extending the signature.
